response.text:
I don’t see the photo attached — please upload the product image you want edited.

A couple quick clarifying points before I edit:
- Confirm you want a square (1:1) catalog crop and roughly what output size/resolution you prefer (e.g., 2000×2000 px)?
- You asked the printed label must stay word-for-word the same. If the glare currently obscures any printed text, do you want me to:
  1) remove glare and reconstruct the underlying text exactly as printed (I can recreate any obscured text), or
  2) only reduce glare and leave any partially-obscured text as-is (may remain faint/partially hidden)?
- For “warm gray” background, do you have a specific shade (hex code) in mind? If not, I’ll use a neutral warm gray (example ~#BDB7B0).

Upload the image and confirm the points above and I’ll produce the edited square catalog shot.
